text: FTTH Broadband Fault Ticket Handling Document ID: SOP_C25_FTTH_FAULT_HANDLING Category: C25 — Broadband & FTTH Services Department: Network Customer Scope: all Version: 1.0 Last Updated: 2026-08-08 Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base Purpose To standardise the diagnosis and field-repair dispatch process for home broadband fault reports. Scope Applies to all channels and customer segments unless a specific exception is noted below. Preconditions Customer identity verified (registered number and OTP where applicable). Account is active and not under a fraud, legal, or compliance hold. Roles & Responsibilities Required Information Registered mobile number / account ID. Nature of the request and any reference numbers already issued. Relevant transaction or ticket ID, where applicable. Procedure Perform remote diagnostics via the ONT telemetry dashboard (PON light status, signal levels). If LOS is confirmed and not resolved by customer-side checks, log a field fault ticket. Dispatch a technician within 24 hours for standard faults, 4 hours for enterprise SLA connections. Apply automatic pro-rated bill credit if downtime exceeds the published SLA threshold. Decision Points If the request falls outside standard criteria, route for manual review before proceeding. If suspected fraud indicators are present at any step, halt standard processing and route per the Fraud & Security Response SOP. Exception Handling Cases outside standard scope require supervisor sign-off before proceeding. Validation Confirm the account/system reflects the expected end state before the case is closed, and obtain customer confirmation where applicable. Escalation Where first-line steps do not resolve the issue within the stated timeframe, the case is escalated to
